newsitem.title: USA: Tranzonic sees flat Q1 sales, higher profits.
newsitem.headline: Tranzonic sees flat Q1 sales, higher profits.

text.p: The Tranzonic Cos chief executive officer Robert Reitman, said Monday at the company's annual meeting, that he expects "substantially flat" sales for the first quarter, ended May 30, but that profits are expected to surpass last year's record first quarter results.

He said that a major priority going forward is to achieve renewed sales growth, adding that "measured growth in the general economy should support that effort, notwithstanding the mature nature of many of our current product lines."
Tranzonic makes natural and synthetic fiber and paper-based products, including personal hygeine and industrial wiping and cleaning products.
In other news, the company also declared its regular quarterly dividend of $0.07 per share, payable July 15 to shareholders of record June 27.
